title: React Frontend Developer
location: Remote; careers page says work from anywhere, Pakistan contract eligibility unconfirmed
description: Frontend product role covering responsive and accessible React interfaces, Figma implementation, REST/state integration, reusable components, testing, performance and work with design/backend colleagues. The full public JD is preserved in laralink-frontend.html. It asks for 3+ years of React, frontend foundations, Redux/Zustand, careful UI work, Git/CI-CD and communication; Next/TypeScript, Jest/RTL and open-source work are optional. Degree requirement absent from this complete public posting.
eligibilityEvidence: Remote is explicitly advertised for this frontend role, and the official careers page says work from anywhere. Other vacancies expressly say Remote / Dhaka; this one does not. No Bangladesh-only restriction, Bangla requirement or other local-language condition appears in the full JD or public form. Pakistan employment/contracting is not explicitly confirmed; the site has Bangladesh offices. The generic footer office hours are not treated as the role schedule.

requirements.text: At least three years of professional React work.
requirements.explanation: Danzee React Developer Jan2022–Jan2024 plus React product work at Tututor Nov2023–present establish more than three calendar years; overlap is not added.

requirements.text: Strong HTML, CSS and current JavaScript skills.
requirements.explanation: Original resume explicitly lists HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Tailwind; reusable components and production booking/interfaces provide applied evidence. No unreported CSS specialty is claimed.

requirements.text: State-management experience using Redux or Zustand.
requirements.explanation: Redux Toolkit and RTK Query are explicitly listed. Zustand is an alternative, not a missing mandatory second tool.

requirements.text: Demonstrate attention to interface detail and clean UI.
requirements.explanation: Reusable React components and hooks, Jurri file/inbox/vault interfaces, and Yaksport search/filter booking UI provide reasonable candidate-reported evidence of careful product-interface delivery. This does not claim Figma expertise, an independent visual assessment, or accessibility specialization.
Git, GitHub, GitLab and CI/CD are explicitly in the original resume; no named cloud expertise or pipeline ownership has been invented.

Reported leadership of web/mobile delivery and direct product/engineering collaboration with the founder support this general collaboration requirement. This is not evidence of an English test level, fluency assertion or future time-zone commitment.

requirements.text: Optional: experience with Next.js or TypeScript.
requirements.explanation: Both tools are explicitly listed; no exact TypeScript tenure is claimed.

requirements.text: Optional: testing knowledge, illustrated by Jest or React Testing Library.
requirements.explanation: Cypress is listed and export golden tests are documented, but Jest/RTL use is not. Do not relabel these as React unit-test evidence.
A public GitHub profile alone does not establish a particular open-source contribution.

notes: Technical fit strong: all six stated essentials are supported by the existing candidate evidence, with no new claims. Country eligibility remains unknown, application not ready.
